verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p="app/(main)/crew/store/actions.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error("SCAN-772: "+p+" missing");process.exit(79)}const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const hasEquip=/export async function (equip|unequip|wear|setEquipped)\w*\s*\(/i.test(s);const nullWrite=/(profile_border|profile_flair|custom_title):\s*(null|value|plan\.value|cosmeticValue\s*\?\?\s*null)/.test(s.slice(s.indexOf("export async function equip")>=0?s.indexOf("export async function equip"):0));if(!hasEquip){console.error("SCAN-772: the store actions export no equip action, so the only writer of profile_border, profile_flair and custom_title is redeemItem at purchase time: a second cosmetic purchase overwrites the first for good and nothing can re-wear or remove one.");process.exit(1)}if(!nullWrite){console.error("SCAN-772: an equip action exists but does not write the cosmetic slot columns, so owned cosmetics still cannot be re-worn or removed.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: New equipCosmetic(itemId | null, slot) action verifies ownership and classification then writes the slot column through the admin client; getStoreData returns each item's slot and equipped state and the shelf offers Equip, Equipped and Remove.
